The Chinese characters for Grace

As a transliteration, Grace is usually written 格蕾丝 (Gé lěi sī). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

Origin and meaning

The name Grace has Latin roots and means “grace, favour”.

About the name Grace

A virtue name, and the actress Grace Kelly, later Princess of Monaco.

As a gift or a tattoo

Because it means “grace, favour”, a Grace calligraphy print makes a thoughtful gift for someone who loves the name or its meaning.
